title: 第11章本座要亲人啦，开心！
slug: 二哈和他的白猫师尊皓衣行
content_zh:
“是、是我！”陈夫人悲泣道，“可是这灵牌不是我写的！我怎么会咒自己的孩子呢？我——”
“醒着的时候你不会写，睡着了却未必。”
楚晚宁说着，抬起手，拿起那块灵牌，掌灌入灵力，灵牌忽然爆发出一阵幽远凄厉的惨叫，紧接着一股浓腥的鲜血从牌位汩汩淌出。
楚晚宁眼寒光凛冽，厉声道：“孽畜嚣张，安敢造次！”
掌灵力大盛，碑上的字迹竟然一点一点地在那惨叫声逼退下去，变得黯淡，最后全然消失。楚晚宁细长冷白的手指再一捏，竟将整个牌位震得粉碎！！
陈家人在后面看得都惊呆了。别说陈家人，连师昧都惊呆了。
他忍不住感叹：“好厉害。”
墨燃心也忍不住感叹，好凶悍。
楚晚宁侧过半张俊秀清丽的脸，面上没有什么表情，只是脸颊边溅上了几点鲜血。他抬起手，细细端详着自己指尖残留的血迹，对陈家的人说道：“你们今天都呆在这个院子里，哪儿都别去。”
此时他们哪里敢有半点违抗，连忙道：“好！好！全听道长吩咐！”
楚晚宁大步走出祠间，浑不在意地擦去自己脸上的斑斑血迹，手指凌空朝陈夫人点了点：“尤其是你，绝不可睡过去。那东西会上身，你哪怕再困，都必须醒着。”
“是……是是是！”陈夫人连声答应，又含着泪，不敢相信地问，“道长，我儿子……是不是……是不是没事了？”
“暂且无恙。”
陈夫人怔住：“暂且？不是一直？那、那要怎样才能保住我儿子性命？”
楚晚宁道：“捉妖。”
陈夫人心焦灼万分，免不了有些失礼，也顾不得客气，急着问：“那道长打算何时去捉？”
“立刻。”
楚晚宁说着，扫了陈家的人一眼，问道：“你们谁知道当初挖到红棺的具体位置在哪里。来个人，带路。”
大儿子的媳妇姓姚，虽然是个女人，但是个子高高的，长得颇有几分英气，虽然脸上布着恐惧，但比起其他人算是镇定的。当下道：“那地方是我和亡夫所选，我清楚位置，我来带道长去吧。”
三个人跟着陈姚氏，一路向北，很快来到陈家买的那块地头。

那里已经拉起了戒严阵，周围毫无人烟，黑魆魆的山丘草木丛生，寂静得连虫鸣鸟叫都没有。
爬到山腰处，视野豁然开阔，陈姚氏说：“三位道长，就是这里了。”
挖出红棺的地方还压着镇墓石，墨燃一看就笑：“这破石头能顶什么用？一看就是外行人才会干的事情，搬了吧。”
陈姚氏有些慌：“镇上的先生说，镇邪兽压着，里面的邪祟才出不来。”
墨燃皮笑肉不笑：“先生真能耐。”
“……”陈姚氏道，“搬、搬搬搬！”
楚晚宁冷淡道：“不必了。”说完抬起手，指尖金光点点，天问听从召唤出现在他掌，紧接着柳藤一甩，石首霎时裂成碎片！楚晚宁面无表情地走过去，站在那一堆废墟上，手掌再一抬，沉声道：“藏着做甚么？给我起来！”
底下发出格格的异响，忽然之间，一具十二尺高的厚木棺材破土而出，一时间沙泥俱下，尘土飞扬。
师昧惊道：“这棺材邪气好重！”
楚晚宁道：“后退。”
说完就是反手一抽，焊死的红棺被天问劈，金色火花四下飞溅，须臾寂静后，棺盖砰然炸裂，滚滚浓烟散去，里头的事物露了出来。
棺材里躺着个浑身赤·裸的男人，鼻梁周正，面目俊俏，如果不是皮肤苍白如纸，他看上去和睡着了也没有任何区别。
墨燃扫了一眼男人的腰腹之下：捂眼道：“哎呀，不穿亵裤，臭流氓。”
师昧：“……”
楚晚宁：“……”
陈姚氏惊呼一声：“夫君！”直冲过去想要靠近那棺材。楚晚宁伸手拦住，挑眉问道：“这是你夫君？”
“是！是我丈夫！”陈姚氏又惊又悲，“他怎么会在这里？明明都已经葬在祖坟了，那时候身上寿衣也穿的好好的，他怎么会……”
说到一半，这女人就嚎啕哭了起来，捶胸顿足地：“怎么会这样！那么惨——那么惨！夫君啊……夫君啊！！”
师妹叹道：“小陈夫人，还请节哀。”
楚晚宁和墨燃两个人却没有理会这个哭泣的女人，楚晚宁是不擅长安慰人，墨燃则是全无爱心，两个人盯着棺椁里的尸身看。

墨燃虽然前世已历经此事，对于会发生什么并没有意外，但模样还是要装一装的，于是摸着下巴：“师尊，这具尸体不对劲啊。”
楚晚宁说：“我知道。”
“……”
墨燃一肚子话，都是前世楚晚宁与他们分析的原句，这辈子想拿出来震一震楚晚宁，结果人家倒好，轻飘飘地丢了句“我知道”出来。
当师父的难道不应该循循然擅诱人，鼓励徒弟说出自己的想法，并且予以赞美和嘉奖的吗？？
墨燃不甘心，佯作没听见那句“不知道”，开口说：“这尸体身上没有腐烂的痕迹，陈大公子出事都已经半个多月了，按照眼下这个气候，早应该溃烂流脓，棺材内尸液都应该积出一层，这是其一。”
楚晚宁以一种“君可续演之”的目光，冷冷看了他一眼：“……”
“其二。”墨燃不为所动，继续背诵楚晚宁上辈子的解惑之词，“开棺前，这红棺的邪气很重，开了之后却反而散掉了。而且这尸体身上的邪气微乎其微，这点也很不正常。”
楚晚宁：“……”
“其三，你们有没有发现，从棺材
那香味很清幽，不注意的话，其实根本发现不了。墨燃这么一说，师昧和陈姚氏才觉察到空气里确实弥漫着一股淡淡的清甜。
师昧道：“确实。”
陈姚氏闻着闻着，脸色就变了：“这个香味……”
师昧道：“小陈夫人，怎么了？”
陈姚氏害怕的嗓音都变了：“这个香味，是我婆婆独制的百蝶香粉啊！”
一时间没有人说话，祠间那块预言灵牌上写着的“阳上人陈孙氏立”似乎又浮现在眼前。
师昧道：“……难道这件事，真的是陈夫人所为？”
墨燃道：“不像。”
楚晚宁道：“不是。”
两人几乎是同时说话，说完之后彼此互相看了一眼。楚晚宁脸上毫无波澜：“你说吧。”

墨燃就不客气地说道：“据我所知，陈家发家致富，靠的就是老夫人特制的百蝶香粉，这个香粉的配方虽然密不外传，但成品却并不难弄到手。彩蝶镇上十个姑娘有五个，涂抹的都是这个香料。非但如此，我们来之前调查过，陈大公子自己好像也十分喜欢母亲调配的百蝶香粉，常在汤浴混入此香泡澡，因此他身上带着这种味道并不奇怪，奇怪的是……”
他说着，再次把头转向棺椁浑身赤·裸的那个男人。
“人都已经死了半个月了，这个香味，居然还跟刚刚抹上去的一样。我说的对不对，师尊？”
楚晚宁：“……”
“说的对就夸我一下嘛。”
楚晚宁：“嗯。”
墨燃哈哈笑起来：“真是惜字如金。”
他还没有笑两下，忽然间衣袍翻飞，楚晚宁拉着他往后疾退数尺，手天问的金光熠熠生辉，火光飞溅。
“当心。”
空气那股百蝶香粉的味道忽然浓郁了起来，随着香味的飘散，草木间浮现滚滚白雾，以惊人的速度开始弥漫，顷刻间将整个山腰化成一片雾海，顿时伸手不见五指！
墨燃心一动。
幻境，开启了。
“啊！！”浓雾，最先传来的是陈姚氏的惨叫声，“道长救——”
最后一个字还未说出口，忽然间就没了声音。
楚晚宁指尖燃起蓝色光泽，在墨燃额上打了个追踪符咒，说道：“你自己当心，我去看看情况。”
说完便循着声音迅速消失在浓雾之。
墨燃摸着自己的额头，低声笑道：“好嘛，连打符咒的位置都和前世一模一样，楚晚宁，你还真是分毫未改。”
大雾来得快，散的也快，没过多久，雾气就消弭无踪了，然而眼前的景象却比大雾还要让人惊奇。至少上辈子墨燃是着实狠狠惊吓了一把。
雾散之后，原本荒凉杂乱，草木丛生的山腰不见了。
取而代之的，是一片广袤精雅的园林，亭台楼阁，水榭曲廊，假山玉树，卵石幽径，一眼望不到头。

墨燃一看这地方，立刻乐得想打滚。
这恶霸流氓成天惦记的就是这个幻境，前世他们也同样迷失其，墨燃先遇到了师昧，在受到幻境蛊惑的情况下，他生平第一次，也是唯一一次吻了对方。
可惜，那时候师昧大概是惊吓的厉害，趁着墨燃松手，转身就跑开了。到嘴的天鹅没啃两下就被撤了盘子，这滋味儿可不好受。
之后幻境破除，师昧也没有跟他计较这事儿，这幻境的亲吻就跟没发生一样，谁都没再提过。有时午夜梦回，墨燃都会怀疑那是不是自己执念太深，生出的臆想。
但是不管是不是臆想，墨燃舔舔嘴唇，心想，这次都绝对不能轻易让师昧跑了！必须得一次亲个够！
作者有话要说：按照史实二十得字，墨燃这个年纪是还没有表字的，但是这个修真界设定十五岁行冠礼，授字。因为私心真的很喜欢墨微雨三个字，觉得比墨燃长得好看，想让它早点出来，哈哈哈哈

"Yes, it's me!" Mrs. Chen sobbed, "But I didn't write this spiritual tablet! How could I curse my own child? I -"
"You can't write when you're awake, but not necessarily when you're asleep."
Chu nightning said, raised his hand, picked up the spiritual tablet, poured spiritual power into his palm, and the spiritual tablet suddenly burst out with a distant and shrill scream, followed by a thick stream of blood gurgling out from the tablet.
Chu nightning's eyes were cold and sharp, and he said sternly: "The evil beast is arrogant, how dare you make a mistake!"
The palm spiritual power was strong, and the handwriting on the tablet was forced back bit by bit by the screams, became dim, and finally disappeared completely. Chu Wanning's slender, cold-white fingers pinched again, and the entire tablet was shattered to pieces! !
The Chen family looked behind in shock. Not to mention the Chen family, even Shi Mo was shocked.
He couldn't help but sigh: "It's amazing."
Mo Ranxin couldn't help but sigh, so fierce.
Chu Wanning turned half of his handsome and beautiful face. There was no expression on his face, except for a little blood splashed on his cheek. He raised his hand, carefully examined the blood stains on his fingertips, and said to the Chen family: "You all stay in this courtyard today, don't go anywhere."
At this time, they didn't dare to disobey in the slightest, so they quickly said: "Okay! Okay! Just follow the Taoist Master's orders!"
Allen Chu strode out of the temple, nonchalantly wiping the blood on his face, and pointed his finger at Mrs. Chen: "Especially you, you must not fall asleep. That thing will get on you, and you must stay awake no matter how sleepy you are."
"Yes...yes, yes!" Mrs. Chen agreed repeatedly, and then asked in disbelief with tears in her eyes, "Taoist Master, is my son...is...is he okay?"
"It's okay for now."
Mrs. Chen was stunned: "For now? Not all the time? Then, how can I save my son's life?"
Chu Wanning said: "Catch the monster."
Mrs. Chen was so anxious that she couldn't help but be a little rude, and she couldn't bear to be polite. She asked anxiously: "When does the Taoist plan to catch him?"
"Immediately."
Chu Wanning said, glanced at the Chen family, and asked: "Which of you knows the specific location where the red coffin was dug. Someone, come and lead the way."
The eldest son's wife's surname is Yao. Although she is a woman, she is tall and quite heroic. Although her face is full of fear, she is calmer than others. Immediately he said: "That place was chosen by my late husband and I. I know the location. I will take the Taoist priest there."
The three people followed Chen Yao's family all the way north, and soon came to the land bought by the Chen family.
Martial law has been set up there, and there are no people around. The dark hills are covered with vegetation, and it is so quiet that there is no chirping of insects or birds.
Climbing to the mountainside, the view suddenly broadened. Chen Yao said: "The three Taoist priests are here."
The place where the red coffin was dug out was still covered with a tomb stone. Mo Ran smiled when he saw it: "What use can this broken stone be used for? At first glance, it seems like something only an outsider would do. Let's move it."
Chen Yao was a little panicked: "The gentleman in the town said that the evil spirits inside can't come out unless the evil beast suppresses it."
The ink-burning skin smiled but the flesh didn't smile: "Sir, you are really capable."
"..." Chen Yao said, "Move, move, move!"
Chu nightning said coldly: "No need." After speaking, he raised his hand, with golden light on his fingertips. Tianwen obeyed the call and appeared in his palm. Then the willow vine flicked, and the stone head instantly broke into pieces! Allen Chu walked over expressionlessly, stood on the pile of ruins, raised his palm again, and said in a deep voice: "What are you hiding? Get up!"
There was a rattling sound underneath, and suddenly, a thick wooden coffin twelve feet high broke out of the ground. For a moment, sand, mud, and dust flew down.
The teacher was shocked and said: "This coffin is so evil!"
Chu nightning said: "Back off."
After saying that, he whipped his backhand, and the welded red coffin was split by Tian Wen. Golden sparks flew everywhere. After a moment of silence, the coffin lid exploded, and the billowing smoke dissipated, revealing the things inside.Lying in the coffin was a naked man, with a straight nose and a handsome face. If his skin were not as pale as paper, he would look the same as if he were asleep.
Mo Ran glanced at the man's waist and abdomen, covered his eyes and said, "Oh, you don't wear obscene pants, you are a stinker."
Teacher: "..."
Allen Chu: "..."
Mrs. Chen Yao exclaimed: "Husband!" and rushed over to get closer to the coffin. Allen Chu stretched out his hand to stop him, raised his eyebrows and asked: "Is this your husband?"
"Yes! It's my husband!" Mrs. Chen Yao was shocked and sad. "Why is he here? He was obviously buried in the ancestral grave, and he was wearing a good shroud at that time. How could he..."
Halfway through the sentence, the woman burst into tears and beat her chest: "How could this happen! So miserable - so miserable! Husband...husband!!"
Junior sister sighed: "Mrs. Chen, please forgive me."
Chu Wanning and Mo Ran ignored the crying woman. Chu Wanning was not good at comforting people, while Mo Ran had no love at all. The two stared at the body in the coffin.
Although Mo Ran had experienced this in his previous life and was not surprised about what would happen, he still had to pretend, so he touched his chin: "Master, there is something wrong with this corpse."
Allen Chu said: "I know."
"..."
Mo Ran's words were all the original sentences analyzed by Chu Wanning and them in the previous life. In this life, he wanted to use them to shock Chu Wanning, but it turned out that he was good and threw out the sentence "I know" lightly.
Shouldn't a master be good at teaching people, encourage his disciples to express their thoughts, and praise and reward them? ?
Mo Ran was unwilling to give in, pretending not to hear the "I don't know", and said: "There are no traces of decay on this corpse. It has been more than half a month since Mr. Chen's accident. According to the current climate, it should have festered and pus-filled, and a layer of corpse fluid should have accumulated in the coffin. This is one of them."
Chu Wanning gave him a cold look with a "You can continue to act" look: "..."
"Second." Mo Ran was unmoved and continued to recite Chu Wanning's words of explanation in his previous life. "Before opening the coffin, the evil spirit of the red coffin was very strong, but after opening it, it dissipated. Moreover, the evil spirit on the corpse was very small, which is also very abnormal."
Allen Chu: "..."
"Thirdly, have you discovered that from the coffin
The fragrance is very subtle, and if you don't pay attention, you won't be able to detect it at all. When Mo Ran said this, Shi Mo and Chen Yao realized that there was indeed a faint sweetness in the air.
The teacher said: "Indeed. "
Chen Yao's face changed as she smelled it: "This fragrance..."
The teacher said, "Mrs. Chen, what's wrong? "
Chen Yao's voice changed with fear: "This fragrance is the Baidie Fragrance Powder specially made by my mother-in-law! "
No one spoke for a while, and the words "Yang Shang Ren Chen Sun Shi Li" written on the prophecy tablet in the temple seemed to come to mind again.
The teacher said: "...could it be that Mrs. Chen really did this? "
Mo Ran said: "It doesn't look like it. "
Chu Wanning said: "No. "
The two spoke almost at the same time, and looked at each other after finishing speaking. Allen Chu's face showed no emotion: "Just tell me. "
Mo Ran said unceremoniously: "As far as I know, the Chen family's fortune depends on the old lady's special Baidie fragrant powder. Although the formula of this fragrant powder is kept secret, the finished product is not difficult to get. Five out of ten girls in Caidi Town are all wearing this spice. Not only that, we investigated before we came here and found that Mr. Chen himself seems to like the Butterfly Fragrance Powder prepared by his mother very much. He often mixes this fragrance into the bath, so it is not surprising that he has this smell on his body. The strange thing is..."
As he spoke, he turned his head again to the naked man in the coffin.
"The person has been dead for half a month, and this fragrance is still the same as when I just applied it.Same as going up. Am I right, Master? "
Allen Chu: "..."
"Just praise me if you're right. "
Allen Chu: "Yeah. "
Mo Ran burst out laughing: "I really cherish words like gold. "
Before he even smiled twice, his clothes suddenly flew up. Chu Wanning pulled him back a few feet. The golden light in his hand was shining brightly, and the fire was splashing.
"Be careful. "
The smell of Baidie fragrant powder in the air suddenly became stronger. As the fragrance spread, billowing white mist appeared among the grass and trees. It began to spread at an alarming speed. In an instant, the entire mountainside turned into a sea of mist, making it impossible to see even one's fingers!
The ink burns and the heart moves.
The fantasy is on.
"Ah! ! "In the thick fog, the first thing that came out was Chen Yao's scream, "Taoist Master, save—"
Before the last word was uttered, there was suddenly no sound.
Allen Chu's fingertips ignited a blue luster, and he put a tracking charm on his forehead and said: "Be careful, I'll go check on the situation. "
After saying that, he followed the voice and quickly disappeared into the thick fog.
Mo Ran touched his forehead and laughed softly: "Well, even the position of the spell is exactly the same as in the previous life. Chu Wanning, you really haven't changed at all. "
The fog came and dissipated quickly. It didn't take long for the fog to disappear without a trace. However, the scene in front of me was even more surprising than the fog. At least Mo Ran was really frightened in his last life.
After the fog cleared, the originally desolate and chaotic mountainside with overgrown vegetation disappeared.
Instead, there is a vast and elegant garden, with pavilions, waterside pavilions, winding corridors, rockeries, jade trees, and pebble paths, stretching as far as the eye can see.
When Mo Ran took a look at this place, he immediately felt so happy that he wanted to roll around.
This bully and gangster has been thinking about this illusion all day long. They were also lost in the past life. Mo Ran first met Shi Mo. Under the spell of the illusion, he kissed the other party for the first and only time in his life.
Unfortunately, Shi Mo was probably very frightened at that time, and while Mo Ran let go, he turned around and ran away. The swan that reached the mouth was removed from the plate without even chewing twice. This was not a pleasant feeling.
After the illusion was broken, Shimo didn't care about it. The kiss in the illusion was as if it never happened, and no one mentioned it again. Sometimes when I dream back in the middle of the night, Mo Ran will wonder if it is a fantasy born out of my deep obsession.
But regardless of whether it was a fantasy or not, Mo Ran licked his lips and thought, this time he must not let Shi Mo run away easily! You have to kiss enough at one time!
The author has something to say: According to historical facts, Mo Ran does not have a Chinese character at this age, but in this world of cultivation, it is set that the age of fifteen will be crowned and given. Because selfishly I really like the word Mo Weiyu, I think it looks better than Mo Ran, and I want it to come out as soon as possible, hahahaha
